To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) Women are more likely than men to have low levels of literacy, numeracy, and computer skills; 2) Women are more than twice as likely as men to have a disability; 3) Women are more vulnerable to poverty than men, especially single mothers and Aboriginal women; 4) Women are more often the sole caregivers for children; and 5) Women are more at risk than men for violence.
